# Governance @ Stage 6 — Nominal & Rule

> **depth_status: complete** — universal developmental content. Ground-reality exemplars are NOT
> named here (universality firewall); real holons cite this cell UP via `stage_lines.governance: 6`.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 6 |
| Canonical name | Nominal & Rule |
| Altitude | `amber` (Ethnocentric) |
| MHC Order | 5 (Sentential) |
| Kegan | 2 (Imperial) |
| Identity band | Ethnocentric (rule & role) |

## Expression on this line

Governance at Stage 6 is the **birth of named authority** — the point where political coordination
escapes the purely egocentric (red warlordism) and crystallizes into stable, nameable roles that
persist across leadership transitions. The mind at MHC Order 5 can chain words into sentences,
which means it can *state rules*: "the chief decides disputes," "the eldest of the lineage
distributes land." Authority is no longer whoever can physically dominate; it is whoever holds
the *named office*. This is the cognitive revolution that makes chiefdoms possible — a hierarchy
of named positions (chief, elder, war-leader, priest) with defined obligations, where obedience
is owed to the *role* rather than to the person's raw coercive capacity.

The legitimacy of governance at this stage rests entirely on **custom and continuity**: "this is
what our ancestors established." There is no written codification, no abstract principle, no
sacred scripture — the rules exist as oral tradition carried by the collective memory of the
group. But they are *real* rules, enforceable through social sanction (shaming, exile,
withdrawal of reciprocity). The feudal obligation structure — lord provides protection, vassal
provides service — is the archetypal Stage 6 governance form. The cognitive operation is
*nominal classification applied to social roles*: sorting people into named categories (free/unfree,
noble/commoner) and assigning fixed behavioral expectations to each category. What Stage 6
cannot yet do is *chain these rules into a coherent system* — each named obligation is a
standalone sentence, not yet integrated into a legislative code or a sacred narrative. That
integration comes at Stage 7.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the individual experiences their social role as identity — "I am a farmer of this
  village" is not a description but a self-definition; duty felt as belonging, not burden.
- **UR:** reliable role-performance — the village headman adjudicates disputes in the customary
  way, every time; the elder distributes resources by precedent; the role-holder is predictable.
- **LL:** shared custom and oral tradition that every member of the group can recite and enforce
  through collective memory; governance is communal storytelling about who does what.
- **LR:** the first durable institutional forms — named offices with defined authority, succession
  rules (often hereditary), and the beginning of territorial organization (village, lineage,
  chiefdom).

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to this stage):** rigid customary hierarchy where "this is how
  it has always been" becomes absolute and unchallengeable — the named role freezes into a
  caste, and questioning the role structure is treated as a violation of the natural order.
  Social mobility becomes structurally impossible because the *name itself* IS the authority.
- **Dark allergy (skipping this stage):** where named authority never consolidated — personalist,
  purely coercive rule persists (red warlordism) with only the thinnest veneer of role-fidelity.
  Orders are given and obeyed because of fear, not because anyone recognizes the office. The
  group has no stable coordination mechanism beyond the leader's physical presence.
- **Golden addiction (premature reach upward):** mimicking Stage 7 faith-legitimated governance
  by inventing mythic origin stories for named roles that were actually created recently —
  retroactively sacralizing customary authority to give it deeper legitimacy than oral tradition
  alone provides.
- **Golden allergy (refusing upward):** refusing to invest named roles with a shared sacred
  narrative — insisting that "we have always done it this way" is sufficient, unable to
  articulate *why* the custom is good, only that it exists. This blocks the transition to
  Stage 7's faith-coordinated governance.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Signal-types that place a governance holon (or a captured part of one) at **amber Stage 6** —
the named-custom authority that persists as substrate beneath later institutional forms:

- **Ascribed status as governance role:** a hereditary caste-like status order where social
  position is inherited and each named category carries fixed behavioral obligations; kin-exogamy
  and endogamy marriage rules serving as the coordination mechanism that reproduces the order.
- **Elder-council adjudication:** local dispute resolution by named elders using customary law,
  not codified statute — the authority is in the role (elder of a lineage), not in any written
  mandate.
- **Kinship-based obligation:** political loyalty tracking lineage rather than territory or
  citizenship — "you owe this to your clan" as the primary governance claim.
- **Absence of written code:** governance operating entirely through oral custom and
  role-exemplification rather than codified law — the rule is what the elder *does*, not what
  a document *says*.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Commons & Dawson (MHC Order 5, Sentential operations); Kegan, *The Evolving Self*
  (order 2, imperial/instrumental); Carneiro, *Chiefdom: Precursor of the State*; Earle,
  *How Chiefs Come to Power* (political evolution from bands to chiefdoms).
- **Open joints:** How does the transition from egocentric (red) to ethnocentric (amber) governance
  specifically operate on the governance line — what is the mechanism by which personal coercion
  becomes role-bound obligation? Is it oral tradition, kinship structure, or economic
  interdependence that first stabilizes named authority?
- **Research debt:** pairs with `07-sentential-faith` (the sacred narrative that binds named roles
  into a moral community) and `05-sensory-motor` (the red warlordism this stage transcends).
  Also cross-links to the `social-systems` line's Stage 6 expression (early kinship
  structures).
